user.title: Connect Yoohoo
user.description: In the Yoohoo app, open Add a source, pick Home Assistant and copy the link it shows.

data_description.url: The private link from your Home Assistant source in Yoohoo.

error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a Yoohoo link. Copy it again from the Home Assistant source in the Yoohoo app.
error.link_gone: Yoohoo doesn't know this link. The source may have been deleted, or a new link made. Copy the current one from the app.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Yoohoo. Check that Home Assistant is online and try again.

abort.already_configured: This link is already set up.

send_alert.name: Send alert
send_alert.description: Sends an alert to Yoohoo. The level decides whether it reaches you now or waits for your roundup.

config_entry_id.name: Yoohoo source
config_entry_id.description: Which Yoohoo source to send to. Only needed when you've set up more than one.

message.name: Message
message.description: More detail, shown under the title.

group.name: Group
group.description: Keeps related alerts together. An All good alert settles earlier problems in the same group.

url.name: Link
url.description: A page to open from the alert.

entry_not_found.message: That Yoohoo source isn't set up, or isn't running.

not_set_up.message: Yoohoo isn't set up yet. Add it under Settings, Devices & services.

pick_entry.message: You have more than one Yoohoo source. Pick which one to send to.

link_gone.title: Yoohoo link stopped working
link_gone.description: Yoohoo no longer knows the link this integration sends to. The source may have been deleted, or a new link made. Remove the Yoohoo integration and add it again with the link from the Yoohoo app.
